newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.

text.p: Consolidation following sharp rises posted last week would put a dent on the Seoul stock market on Tuesday, brokers said.
But they said steadily rising customer deposits with brokerage houses would limit sharp falls.

"The market will be weak just for a technical reason," said Park Key-pyong of Hanyang Securities. "The yen/dollar movement will be a key issue for the time being as the rate will decide the future direction of foreign investors."
The composite stock index closed on Monday at 718.99, down 6.18 points. -- Yeom Yoon-jeong (822) 727 5647
